signature.name: VTask.prevFixed
signature.type: {α : Type u} -> [CompleteLattice α] -> (f : α →o α) -> (x : α) -> (hx : f x ≤ x) -> ↑(Function.fixedPoints ⇑f)

conventions.note: NONE_DECLARED: The function is total on its stated domain (monotone maps and post-fixed points), and the complete lattice structure guarantees the greatest fixed point below x always exists; no junk-value or edge conventions are needed.

facts.statement: ∀ {α : Type*} [inst : CompleteLattice α] (f : α →o α) (x : α) (hx : f x ≤ x), (VTask.prevFixed f x hx : α) ≤ x
